story: The Bornean Banded Pitta (Hydrornis schwaneri) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Pittidae family. It is most commonly observed in Hill and lowland dipterocarp forests; dry ridges; hilltops; limestone areas; and secondary forest, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Bornean Banded Pitta is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Bornean Banded Pitta into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
